description: This file defines the RetryConfigurationAssembler class which configures and provides Retry instances using the resilience4j library for handling retries in various command execution scenarios within the Fineract project.

classes.name: RetryConfigurationAssembler
classes.description: A service component responsible for assembling and providing configured Retry instances for different operational scenarios within the application.

methods.name: isAssignableFrom
methods.description: Checks if the exception e is assignable from any of the exception classes in the provided list.

methods.name: setLastException
methods.description: Records the last exception class in the request context holder.

methods.name: getLastException
methods.description: Retrieves the last exception class recorded during retry attempts.

methods.name: getRetryConfigurationForExecuteCommand
methods.description: Creates a Retry instance for executing commands, configured based on properties and exception handling logic.

methods.name: getRetryConfigurationForBatchApiWithEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Creates a Retry instance for batch API calls with exception handling that considers underlying causes, especially for BatchExecutionException.

methods.name: buildCommonExecuteCommandConfiguration
methods.description: Builds a common RetryConfig.Builder with settings such as max attempts, wait duration, and exponential backoff.

methods.name: getRetryConfigurationForCommandResultPersistence
methods.description: Creates a Retry instance specifically for command result persistence operations, excluding retries for CommandResultPersistenceException.
